requirements.title: Readable stakes and bounded recovery
requirements.obligation: Define each threat warning, cause, consequence, exposure limit, counterplay, recovery, grace/repeat/offline behavior and save semantics. Apply the selected U3 loss policy explicitly; never present authored rules as observed footage or implemented scene behavior. Current U3 additions: While the player or an eligible living defending pet is within the camp's defense range, enemies target eligible reachable player/pet/camp objectives. An unprovoked survivor is ineligible as a direct target, including when every preferred target is absent or blocked. Seek a valid approach or blocking defense instead. An enemy may directly retaliate against the survivor that attacks it; both player and eligible defending pets being far permits unrestricted targets. This does not grant collateral damage immunity: an actual valid contact can still hurt a survivor. When both player and defending pets are beyond the warned defense boundary, hostile encounter policy permits all characters and destructible camp structures as targets. Hysteresis stabilizes the boundary. Distance-based rendering or region unloading cannot delete the logical encounter, heal enemies or fabricate offscreen loot. Ordinary simulation pauses while backgrounded/closed. Fences and gates have substantial authored HP but can be breached. Every placed camp/field equipment class has HP and damaged/destroyed states. Breaches change collision and pathing at the actual commit. Interior safety comes from intact defenses, defenders and enemy behavior; standing inside camp is not permanent invulnerability. Furnace destruction puts that camp into blackout: pause automated production, new customer admission and ordinary non-recovery worker jobs; preserve already committed value. Rebuild the furnace at level1 with a substantial progression/lost-tier raw-material bill, then re-earn upgrades. Manual gathering, recovery jobs, salvage/cash collection, combat and construction remain possible. Scheduled raids require a full five-minute (300 active seconds) warning naming the threatened camp, with a saved 5:00 countdown, sound and equivalent muted cue; no scheduled-raid damage occurs before it expires. If admission is due while ineligible, wait and then give the full warning. This does not cancel real roaming threats.

requirements.title: Persistent loss, cargo and recovery integrity
requirements.obligation: Preserve authoritative cargo, purchase and recovery receipts through cancellation, defeat if designed, app suspension, crash, reconnect and migration; no duplicated payout/debit or repeated committed penalty. Current U3 additions: Repair plots quote materials appropriate to asset/tier and missing HP. A repair job has a fixed authorized HP/material budget; new damage cannot be erased for free. Fence/gate ruins may be reconstructed through the repair plot at their purchased tier. Uncommitted escrow returns safely when the asset generation changes. Non-boundary equipment at zero HP becomes a ruin. Rebuy through the appropriate plot using a new generation and level 1 equipment. Account progression and known recipes remain unlocked, but lost equipment upgrades must be purchased again. Persist destruction; cancel/refund only uncommitted work, not already consumed production or repairs. Pets and survivors can die. Death tombstones the live instance, cancels its attacks/jobs/reservations and requires an ordinary earnable-resource/cash replacement purchase. A new instance is created once; preserve earned companion level/XP/skills, account unlocks and permanent paid entitlements because the user only required equipment level resets. No free care revival or automatic respawn. Dead companion cargo and destroyed equipment/counter/storage contents move once into persistent typed salvage custody. Recovering that cache is a real reachable job. Already sold customer goods are no longer player stock and do not become resale loot on visitor death. All ownership remains single-valued across transitions. Retain permanent baseline player gathering capability and a reachable renewable manual wood/stone path. Recovery bills cannot require a destroyed producer, new customer payout, premium purchase or companion. A finite saved siege objective/attack budget ends in retreat after core defeat without a victory reward; scheduled new camp raids pause through reconstruction, while roaming threats remain real.
